maria: Quick weekly health check - AcmePayments
maria: last 24h: tokens 1.2M (-3% w/w), spend $9.4k (+22% w/w), P95 gen latency 780ms (was 450ms), error/fallback rate 8% (baseline ~0.5%). Model mix shifted: rw-instruct-13b -> rw-instruct-13b-quant (canary) and rw-compat-emu for edge cases.
alyssa: Thanks. What's the canary percentage?
maria: Canary was 40% of new chat requests from the SDK since 03:00 UTC, rest at 60% on stable rw-instruct-13b pinned. Breakdown from console: canary saw 12k reqs, fallback 12.3% vs stable fallback 0.9%.
sam: Looking at infra: most fallbacks are 503 due to GPU OOM on sequences >2048 tokens, OOM spike aligned with retry throttles. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T11:12:05Z ERROR serve: request failed: OOM allocating KV cache for seq_len=3072 model=rw-instruct-13b-quant
```
sam: The quant variant's KV layout increases per-request memory footprint; autoscaler didn't add burst nodes fast enough for that traffic shape.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-20T10:45 rw-instruct-13b-quant canary -> 40% traffic
alyssa: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- scale canary down to 20% traffic
- enable quicker fallback to stable model (lower timeout from 500ms -> 200ms)
- add seq_len check in routing to send >2048 token requests to stable until quant is patched
maria: I'll coordinate CS outreach to Acme (explain transient regression and mitigations) and schedule 30-min sync with their engineering tomorrow 14:00 PDT.
sam: I'll push autoscaler tweak and a short-term routing patch today; will post PR link.
alyssa: I'll draft a short internal postmortem and cost delta analysis (estimated monthly impact if not fixed: +$8k).
maria: Thanks team — will post the outreach copy and console charts to #customer-success after the sync. :thumbsup:
